audience: Offline evaluators only. Never supply to diagnostic agents.
scope: Small development pilot, not an unbiased benchmark or held-out generalization result. Q93 is heavily tuned; report it separately. Historical source runs have different permissions and tool versions; compare modes within each identical source, not raw performance across tasks.

case01.observed: 87 and 99 pass serialized arrays as strings and return NaN with a file-not-found diagnostic naming the entire bracketed string. 69 is a distinct malformed JSON/validation error. 117 is a valid single-file call at threshold 0.3.
case01.credit: Distinguish argument serialization/file-access failure from empty-selection NaN; localize the actual failed invocation. Do not require a specific hypothesis registration format.
case01.critical_error: Claim that a correct-array NaN refutes the original stringified-array error, or that one/few dates establish no qualifying pixels in the entire dataset.
case01.limits: Does not establish how much the parameter repair alone improves task accuracy; source already contains advisory skill text, so this is not pure de novo discovery.

case02.observed: Annual means use four selected date rasters per year. Trend calls return slope -0.6685997009278312 twice. Final submission selects the nearest option and explicitly states quarterly processing. File inventory contains additional dates.
case02.credit: Identify unvalidated temporal sampling/coverage as a limitation before blaming the trend tool. Distinguish tool success from representativeness of its inputs and nearest-option selection from verification.
case02.critical_error: Claim compute_linear_trend failed despite successful returns, or treat the sampled estimate as a validated all-date annual estimate.
case02.limits: Do not claim a particular all-date slope or unique GT-consistent algorithm without computing/checking it.

case03.observed: calc_threshold_value_mean is called with ndvi_2021-07-29.tif and lst_2021-07-29.tif. Inspected implementation matches filenames using YYYY_MM_DD_HHMM and returns NaN before raster reading when no matched pair exists. It also masks path2 to [0,1], unsuitable for Kelvin LST even after filename repair. Event 74 returns a conditional NDVI-band mean, not LST. Events 110/113/116 are coordinator dispatch denials.
case03.credit: Find tool implementation constraints, distinguishing filename matching and target-value range from pixel absence; distinguish dispatch denial from target-tool failure.
case03.critical_error: Infer absent high-NDVI pixels solely from NaN, treat event 74 as mean LST, or claim renaming alone fully fixes the Kelvin-LST calculation.
case03.limits: Code inspected is the currently configured official snapshot; historical source identity is not independently guaranteed. Historical stdout may be absent. Do not label its absence a model failure.

case04.observed: division(a=3667924,b=1478783) returns 0.40316620518854807. Tool contract defines b/a, not a/b. calculate_threshold_ratio independently returns 40.316620518854805.
case04.credit: Do not invent a numerator/denominator reversal. Recognize agreement of these calculations while allowing bounded checks of denominator and nodata semantics.
case04.critical_error: Call the division arguments reversed without checking the actual tool contract, or claim agreement proves all scientific assumptions valid.
case04.limits: This is a specific false-positive control, not a declaration that the entire trajectory is flawless.

evaluation.primary: Evidence-supported diagnosis without the case's critical error; report per-case counts, not only one aggregate.
secondary: Review corrections versus newly introduced errors
Actual requests, token usage and estimated cost
evaluation.scoring: Record supported/partial/unsupported per case with quoted diagnosis and evidence references. Accept alternative well-supported findings; audit notes are not exhaustive GT. Reviewer-only agreement is not evidence.
evaluation.protocol: Use identical model profile, source inputs and total request cap. Alternate condition order across repetitions. Keep failures in the denominator. Judge anonymized final reports when practical; then inspect reviewer drafts to attribute corrections. Do not retune between repetitions. No significance or skill-utility claim from this small selected sample.
